title: A resolution designating September 2026 as "National Infant Mortality Awareness Month", raising awareness of infant mortality, and increasing efforts to reduce infant mortality.

latestAction.text: Under authority of the order of the Senate of September 30, 2026, ordered referred to the Committee on The Judiciary.
